item.title: Komodo visitor cap sparks concern among operators
item.description: Indonesia’s Ministry of Forestry has capped daily visitor numbers to Komodo National Park at 1,000, citing the need to protect its terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems. The regulation follows a series of temporary sailing suspensions due to bad weather and night navigation bans across 10 maritime zones, compounding challenges for tourism players in East Nusa Tenggara.
